Governance Risk Compliance

Recertificação de acesso

A formal process to periodically review and validate user access rights to systems and data to ensure only authorized personnel retain access, as required by regulatory and security policies.

What is Recertificação de acesso?

In this glossary, Recertificação de acesso refers to: A formal process to periodically review and validate user access rights to systems and data to ensure only authorized personnel retain access, as required by regulatory and security policies.

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "O processo trimestral de recertificação de acesso garante que apenas funcionários atuais tenham acesso ativo a aplicações críticas."

Definition

A formal process to periodically review and validate user access rights to systems and data to ensure only authorized personnel retain access, as required by regulatory and security policies.

Operational example

The quarterly access recertification process ensures that only current employees have active access to critical applications.

Localized term

Recertificação de acesso

Localized example

O processo trimestral de recertificação de acesso garante que apenas funcionários atuais tenham acesso ativo a aplicações críticas.
